items.title: What Is Charles Schwab (SCHW) Signaling By Adding Solana, Avalanche And Chainlink?
items.summary: Charles Schwab (NYSE:SCHW) is expanding retail crypto trading to include Solana, Avalanche, and Chainlink on its platform. The new tokens are being offered alongside Bitcoin and Ethereum within existing brokerage accounts for eligible Schwab clients.
